I designed 3qu3str14n 3st4t3 as a background LoRA concept for a quiet, high-end English country equestrian estate. I wanted heritage luxury with believable materials: old brick, aged timber, worn leather, polished brass, soft dawn mist and restrained cinematic light.

Each space has four compositions; a final ground-level stable aisle closes the set. Sand, brick pavers, parquet, grass, tile, rubber and linoleum give each location its own identity.

These are empty backgrounds, without people or horses, real brands, stable names, competition names or readable text. Saddles and equipment stay on racks, stands and hooks. The training dataset is prepared; training and model performance have not been verified.

🪐 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐏𝐑𝐄𝐌𝐈𝐒𝐄

Zenithium is a celestial style that mixes cosmic imagery with cyberpunk and sci fi aesthetics. Its look relies on saturated neon color against deep black or flat solid backdrops, with iridescent rainbow light streaks, chromatic aberration, glitch and pixel distortion effects, and fragmented or disintegrating forms. Halos, rings, black holes, portals, galaxies and nebula textures, alongside strong silhouettes, masked or faceless figures, futuristic elements. Fine details like thin graphic lines, technical overlays and invented glyphs add a poster like feel. Compositions are bold and symmetrical with a strong sense of scale, and the finish is a painterly digital look with soft grain and glowing highlights. It handles both clean flat color layouts and richly detailed cinematic scenes.
